gloss: main part; principal section; core portion

definitions.gloss: main part; principal section; core portion
definitions.explanation: The central or most important part of a structure, document, machine, or system. Used to single out the essential portion from secondary or peripheral ones.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{主要部|しゅようぶ}が{完成|かんせい}した。
examples.english: The main part of the building is finished.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{主要部|しゅようぶ}だけを{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read only the main part of the report.

examples.japanese: システムの{主要部|しゅようぶ}に{不具合|ふぐあい}が{見|み}つかり、{復旧|ふっきゅう}に{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: A fault was found in the core part of the system, and recovery took a long time.

notes:
Formed from {主要|しゅよう} (main, principal) plus the suffix {部|ぶ} (part, section). It picks out the central portion of something composed of several parts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主要部|しゅようぶ}を{占|し}める: to make up the main part
- {主要部|しゅようぶ}が{完成|かんせい}する: the main part is completed
- システムの{主要部|しゅようぶ}: the core of the system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: central part — emphasizes physical or geographic center
- {根幹|こんかん}: backbone, core — the most fundamental basis, more abstract
